author: Pallas, 1764
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록

months.note: 봄에는 3~5월, 가을에는 9~11월에 지나가며, 겨울에도 드물게 기록된다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 우리나라를 지나가는 나그네새로, 바닷가 간석지 같은 곳에서 지낸다. 주로 곤충을 먹지만 작은 조개, 올챙이, 작은 물고기, 갑각류도 먹는다. 알은 4개를 낳는다. 국내에서는 서울, 일산, 장단, 개성, 안주, 해주, 만포, 온성, 용암포, 포항 등지를 거쳐 간다.

points.en: dark grey head and neck with white chin (breeding)
slightly glossy upperparts scattered with white spots (breeding)

young: 어린새는 윗면이 어른 겨울깃보다 짙은 회갈색이고 흰 점무늬가 촘촘하며, 아랫면에 회갈색 세로줄과 가로줄이 빽빽해 겨울깃보다 어둡게 보인다.

similar.how: 붉은발도요는 몸이 조금 작고 부리가 짧으며, 날 때 날개 뒷가장자리가 넓게 희게 보이지만 학도요는 날개에 흰 부분이 거의 없다.

art.subject: Spotted Redshank (Tringa erythropus), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean tidal flats in late April and May: head, neck and underparts sooty black, with a small white chin and a thin broken white eye-ring; some white fringes on the vent and undertail; back, scapulars and wing coverts blackish with a slight gloss, finely spotted and notched white; a narrow white oval on the lower back and rump, mostly hidden at rest; tail barred black and white. Long, slender black bill with a dark red base to the lower mandible; dark eye; legs dark red, almost blackish-red.
art.pose: wading in shallow water on a tidal flat, side view
art.scene: Korean coastal tidal flat with shallow pools during spring migration in late April–May, soft morning light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (late April–May), side view wading: sooty black head, neck and underparts, small white chin, blackish upperparts finely spotted white, thin white eye-ring, long needle-thin bill with a red base to the lower mandible, dark red legs

adult winter, side view standing: plain pale ash-grey head and upperparts with fine white fringes, bold white supercilium in front of the eye above a dark loral stripe, pale grey streaks on the neck sides, white underparts, long bill with a red base below, bright orange-red legs

adult in flight seen from above: plain dark upperwing without white patches, narrow white oval on the lower back and rump, black uppertail coverts barred white, finely barred tail, legs projecting beyond the tail tip
art.build: Elegant, slim wader, 32.5cm long, a little larger and longer-legged than Common Redshank; long neck and small head. Bill long — clearly longer than the head — very thin and straight, with a slight droop at the very tip. Legs long, the tibia well exposed. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight plain dark upperwing with no white trailing edge, a narrow white oval up the back, barred tail and feet projecting beyond the tail tip. Often wades belly-deep and even swims.
avoid: Do not paint a broad white trailing edge on the wing — that is Common Redshank (Tringa totanus).
Do not paint brown streaked plumage with bright orange legs on the breeding bird; breeding adults are sooty black with dark red legs.
Do not paint a thick or upturned bill; it is long, needle-thin and straight with a slight droop at the tip.
Do not paint green or yellow legs — that is Common Greenshank.
